definition: Direct a r is successful immediate cognitive access to a presentation r. This is not mere exposure to a stimulus; no inference from perception alone or from participation alone supplies Direct. Knows targets the represented object in the mediation test, whereas Direct targets its presentation.
note: Additive interface for issue #259. Parmenides 130e–131e and 133b–134e, Phaedo 74b–d / 100d–e and Aristotle Metaphysics I.9 motivate these contrasts; none defines the modern typed interface. Sourcing a replacement would require a passage fixing this exact scope.
